items.q: I worked for Fletcher later on. I made arrangements for him and I made him a lot of things.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, I think I made that arrangement for them. Later on. I worked for Fletcher later on. I made arrangements for him and I made him a lot of things. I did some things of his.
How long were you in New York this first time?
